map.输入新车价、车龄与年里程，按年限法与里程法估算二手车残值，并给出综合估值。: Enter the new-car price, vehicle age, and annual mileage to estimate the used-car residual value by the age method and the mileage method, then give a combined valuation.
map.残值 ≈ 新车价 × (1 − 年折旧率)^车龄 − 里程超额折旧: Residual ≈ new price × (1 − annual depreciation)^age − excess mileage depreciation
map.基于二手车残值经验模型：以新车价按年折旧率复利折减，结合年里程与每万公里折旧率修: Based on an empirical used-car residual model: the new price is compounded-down by the annual depreciation rate, adjusted by annual mileage and per-10,000-km depreciation, for used-car valuation.
map.💡 年限法残值 = 新车价 × (1 − 年折旧率)^车龄；里程法残值 = 新车: 💡 Age-method residual = new price × (1 − annual rate)^age; mileage-method residual = new price × (1 − per-10k-km rate)^(age×annual mileage); combined residual = age-method×0.5 + mileage-method×0.5. Residual rate not below 5% (scrap floor).
map.估算结果仅供参考，实际车价受品牌、车况、地区影响: The estimate is for reference only; the actual price is affected by brand, condition, and region.
map.首年贬值通常高于后续年份，可适当提高年折旧率: First-year depreciation is usually higher than later years; the annual rate may be raised accordingly.
map.事故车、泡水车残值会大幅低于估算: Accident or flooded cars have a residual far below the estimate.
map.📚 深度解析：二手车综合残值估算（年限法+里程法）: 📚 Deep Dive: Combined Used-Car Residual Estimation (Age Method + Mileage Method)
map.：结合车龄与行驶里程给出综合残值区间: : combine age and mileage to give a residual-value range.
map.资产折旧核算：企业车辆账面残值参考: Asset depreciation accounting: book residual reference for company vehicles.
map.换购决策：对比不同车龄/里程下的贬值率: Trade-in decision: compare depreciation under different ages / mileages.
map.年限法残值=新车价×(1−年限贬值率)^车龄；里程法残值=新车价×(1−里程贬值: Age-method residual = new price×(1−age rate)^age; mileage-method residual = new price×(1−mileage rate)^total mileage (total mileage = age×annual mileage); combined residual = 50/50 average of the two, with a 5% residual floor (scrap value); combined depreciation rate = 1 − combined residual ÷ new price.
map.新车价 15 万、车龄 5 年、年均 1.5 万 km、年限贬值率 15%、里程: New price 150k, age 5 yr, 15k km/yr, age rate 15%, mileage rate 6%: total 75k km, age-method residual 66.56k, mileage-method 94.31k, combined 80.43k (depreciation 46.38%); age-method dep 55.63%, mileage-method dep 37.13%; 5% floor 7.5k not triggered.
map.为什么要年限法和里程法取平均？: Why average the age and mileage methods?
map.只按车龄会高估低里程车、只按里程会高估高龄车；各取一半可兼顾使用强度与时间老化，: Age-only overestimates low-mileage cars; mileage-only overestimates old cars; taking half each balances usage intensity and time aging, closer to market reality.
map.5% 残值下限是什么意思？: What does the 5% residual floor mean?
map.车辆接近报废仍有残值（拆解/金属回收），综合残值低于新车价 5% 时按 5% 保: Even near scrap, a car still has value (dismantling / metal recycling); when combined residual falls below 5% of the new price, it is floored at 5% to avoid a negative or zero estimate.
map.关于「二手车残值估算」: About the Used-Car Residual Value Estimator
map.二手车残值估算器综合年限折旧法与里程折旧法，根据新车价、车龄与年里程估算车辆当前: The used-car residual estimator combines the age-depreciation method and the mileage-depreciation method. From new price, age, and annual mileage it estimates the current residual value and depreciation, suitable for used-car trading appraisal and asset depreciation accounting.
